# Orienting

> Orienting is Tzu-Ting Wang's independent advisory practice for marketplace operators, seller-service businesses, and cross-border sellers entering or scaling across Europe.

## Principal

Tzu-Ting Wang has 15+ years of experience across product, risk, compliance, finance, and advisory work. She spent 10 years at Amazon's European headquarters and previously worked at Deloitte and KPMG. She works in English and Chinese and is based in Luxembourg.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/wangtzuting/
- Events: https://luma.com/user/usr-sBGOoekdV7BDtQ0

## What Orienting helps with

- Marketplace seller onboarding, verification, product requirements, enforcement, evidence, and ownership
- European seller expansion across markets, channels, VAT, EPR, packaging, product rules, fulfilment, and partners
- Product, partner, responsibility, control, and operating decisions shaped by European requirements
